text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Success of President Ben Ali's mediation to ease tension between Libya and Mauritania.
- Algeria will supply Tunisia with gas during next 23 years under contract signed on Monday.
- World Bank says it is ready to increase cooperation with Tunisia.
- Mediterranean building exhibition "Medibat 97" to be held in Sfax March 13-16.
- Tunisia and Canada hold talks on reinforcing cooperation in transport sector.
